name: together-deepseek-v4-flash
cached_price_note: G1 ruling 2026-08-15: the cached-input rate is KNOWN ($0.03/Mtok; together.ai model page fetched 2026-08-07, recorded at walkthrough/paper_pipeline/phase_1/config.json `_price_per_mtok`) and is deliberately NOT set as cached_input_per_mtok. The harness's own embedded cost_usd bills every input token at the FULL rate — config.json's doctrine: 'the conservative direction and is what a hard [...] ledger cap deserves' — and spend.py's recomputation must stay equal to the rows' own arithmetic. Rejected alternative, by name: adding cached_input_per_mtok 0.03 here.
batch_billing_note: G1 ruling 2026-08-15: this model runs under together's Batch API (config execution.mode=batch), which bills at a ~50% discount whose applicability to this model was still UNRESOLVED in resolve_runs/graph_v2/BATCH_DESIGN.md when it was written. Batch-billed rows are NOT identifiable in usage.jsonl — dispatch_core's batch collector ledgers them through the same response_envelope as live calls, cost_usd at list price, no row field marks the billing path — so where batch billing applied, list-price totals like this one may OVERSTATE actual cost. Rejected alternatives, by name: pricing all rows at half list (unidentifiable rows would be under-priced, the wrong direction), and adding a batch marker to ledger rows (requires editing files another console owns, and cannot retro-mark rows already logged).
